verify_detail: fully reset app state between runs, so it intermittently (≈1/3 of the time) hits a code path that renders a different (buttonless) sync-status variant. The fix is either in the app (don\'t conditionally omit "Retry sync" for the unavailable state, or stop randomizing sync status on warm restarts) or in the test harness (actually clear app data/reinstall before each run instead of just force-stopping it) — whichever matches the intended behavior should be confirmed with whoever owns BenchTarget.'
